whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text: Today is the day. We have finally done it. I'm sure you can see it there. A nice Gaussian green beam output coming out of the aperture of the front of the laser here. Wow, that was a process, but I've done it. I'm very excited and I sometimes really impress myself with the skills that I'll pick up, but the master oscillator is firing. The entire cavity is realigned and we are running in low energy pilot mode with 526.5 nanometers. The last thing that I have on my plate here is to get the amplifier firing and this laser is going back into service. Very exciting day. I want to thank everybody for all the feedback and everybody's support. I'm going to go ahead and get my camera out of the way. I want to thank everybody who's helped me along the way, but we've done it. Let's go, man. There you go. There's the quick update for today. Thank you.
